thread:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 — Canary error surge in us-east-1 for release/2026-05-12 :rotating_light:

 sara: getting a flood of 502s in the canary group. runtime logs show KMS decrypt errors when reading REDWOOD_API_SECRET.

 dan: same. stacktrace excerpt:
 ```
 ERROR: Failed to decrypt env REDWOOD_API_SECRET: AccessDeniedException: User arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/redeployer-role is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/abcd-rotated
 ```

 maya: @sara @dan who pushed the key rotation? Did the deploy include the new key alias?

 sara: rotation ran this morning, alias changed to alias/ri-deploy-key-v2. canaries pulled the new alias but redeployer-role apparently lacks permission on the new key.

 opsbot: Runbook suggestion: (1) kill feature flag ff:new-routing-v2 -> OFF, (2) rollback canary to previous rev, (3) temporary paramstore fallback.

 mike: flip the flag first to immediately cut traffic to the new path.

 maya: flipping ff:new-routing-v2 OFF now (audit: maya).

 sara: metrics: error rate dropping from 34% -> 4% within 90s. good.

 dan: initiating canary rollback to rev-20260511: `/deploy rollback canary --to rev-20260511`.

 mike: we need a hotfix for the IAM/KMS grant so next deploy doesn't hit this.

 sara: creating a quick hotfix. terraform snippet below (temp grant):
 ```hcl
 resource "aws_kms_key_policy" "allow_redeploy" {
   statement = [{
     "Effect" = "Allow",
     "Principal" = { "AWS" = "arn:aws:iam::111:role/redeployer-role" },
     "Action" = ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"]
   }]
 }
 ```

 opsbot: Canary rollback started by dan. Monitoring.

 julian: paging oncall for awareness @oncall-eng.

 oncall-eng: acked by julian.

 dan: rollback complete. canary running rev-20260511, error rates back to baseline.

 cs-bot: CS note: transient 502s observed ~4 minutes in us-east-1 for a small subset of customers (<0.5%). advise CS to prepare comms if tickets increase.

 mike: audit SecretsManager to ensure no secrets were encrypted with wrong key.

 sara: quick grep shows rotation job wrote new key alias but no writes used it for production secrets. reads were failing only. escalating to security to validate.

 maya: applied temp KMS grant to redeployer-role and notified security. will remove hotfix and implement a permanent infra PR after the postmortem.

 julian: oncall handoff in 20m. pairing with @maya to brief next oncall. status: mitigated, rollback done, hotfix in place, audit in progress, CS notified.

 mike: canaries healthy now?

 opsbot: Canary health: 14/14 passing. error_rate_us-east-1: 0.8% (baseline 0.6%).

 julian: marking incident mitigated. postmortem owners: sara + maya. draft due EOD.

 sara: postmortem will include timeline, logs, terraform snippet, and remediations: 1) automated IAM checks during key rotations, 2) preflight canary permission validation, 3) improve kill-switch runbook.

 dan: added deploy note: "rolled back canary due to KMS permission mismatch after key rotation. temp IAM grant applied; security to review."

 maya: handing off to night oncall. escalate to me if canaries spike.

 julian: final status -> RESOLVED (mitigated). creating PM-1543 (postmortem), SRE-420 (infra IAM fix), CS-77 (customer comms).

 incident-bot: Incident closed: SEV2 -> RESOLVED. duration ~7m.

 sara: thanks all.

 maya: nice quick rollback :thumbsup:

 julian: following up in #eng-releases for process items.
